name: Veripoint
tagline: Company financial research with evidence and saved workspace reports.
description: Research private and public company financials, inspect supporting evidence and retrieve saved workspace reports. The hosted Veripoint MCP service exposes research_company, list_reports, get_report and get_usage over Streamable HTTP with OAuth. A completed analysis consumes a workspace search; reading saved reports and checking usage do not. Financial coverage varies by company, jurisdiction and reporting period. Requires an authorized Veripoint workspace.

install.notes: Create or sign in to a Veripoint workspace, link an active workspace key at https://veripoint.sens663.chatgpt.site/mcp-link, then authorize OAuth in your client. Setup: https://veripoint.ai/api-docs/mcp-setup. No credentials are included in the listing.
